items.name: essential-dialog
items.title: Essential Dialog
items.description: A native <dialog> that morphs out of its own trigger and back into it, driven by Motion's projection engine. Drop-in API parity with shadcn/ui Dialog: Trigger, Content, Header, Title, Description, Footer, Close and `render` composition. Drag it anywhere to dismiss, click outside to close, and every visual value is a CSS variable. Nothing inside imports from components/ui, so the content stays entirely yours.
items.author: Anthony Cifuentes
items.docs: Trigger geometry is the origin of the animation, so the trigger must be a real DOM node — compose it with `render={<Button />}`. Size the dialog through --essential-dialog-width rather than a max-w-* class. Pass `debug` to outline every layer and log the boxes, coverage and drag thresholds the morph is built from. Prefer GSAP? `essential-dialog-gsap` is the same component on GSAP Flip, exporting the same names — one import line apart.

items.name: essential-dialog-gsap
items.title: Essential Dialog (GSAP)
items.description: The same morphing <dialog>, driven by GSAP Flip instead of Motion — it animates a real width and height rather than projecting a transform. Exports exactly the same names as `essential-dialog`, so the two are interchangeable by import path. Reach for it if you would rather not add Motion to the bundle.
items.author: Anthony Cifuentes
items.docs: Identical API to `essential-dialog` apart from two Motion-only props: `bounce` (the opening spring's overshoot) and `dismissOnOutsideClick` (always on here). Flip and CustomEase have been free since GSAP 3.13.

items.title: Essential Dialog Demo
items.description: The shadcn/ui Dialog demo, swapped over to essential-dialog: same Button, Field, Input and Label children, morphing entry and exit.
items.author: Anthony Cifuentes
